question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

The editor of a dictionary
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Lexicographer'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The person who compiles or edits a dictionary is called a **"Lexicographer"** (शब्दकोश संपादक).
 
• Therefore, **"Lexicographer" **is the most fitting substitute for the phrase "The editor of a dictionary".

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Lexicographer'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Scenographer" **(दृश्य विन्यासकार) designs sets and scenes for theater productions.
 
• **"Stenographer" **(आशुलिपिक) specializes in transcribing speech.
 
• **"Hagiographer"** (संत चरित्र लेखक) writes about the lives of saints.

35:Taba,
The correct answer is 'Option 3&#
